title: Joe Kohlmann, Stillwater City Administrator
script:
This is the New Saint Croix Union. Wednesday's biography is Joe Kohlmann, Stillwater City Administrator.

Joe Kohlmann served as City Administrator of St. Francis. At the May 18, 2015, City Council meeting, his first, he thanked people for coming out. He said he enjoyed the first city council meeting and looked forward to many years of serving that community. Council members welcomed him as the new city administrator.

He held the St. Francis post through 2021. In 2022 the Stillwater City Council appointed him City Administrator. Previously he was the Administrator for the City of St. Francis. He handles the daily management of city business and the administration of policy as directed by the Council.

The pages are in the show notes.
